newsitem.title: CHINA: Tai-I Electric unit sets two-tranche FRN.
newsitem.headline: Tai-I Electric unit sets two-tranche FRN.

text.p: Tai-I International (Singapore) Pte Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tai-I Electric Wire & Cable Co Ltd, launched a US$40 million two-tranche floating rate notes issue, arranger Credit Lyonnais said on Thursday.
Taiwan's Tai-I Electric Wire & Cable is the guarantor.
Tranche A of US$30 million is being syndicated, while tranche B of US$10 million is being privately placed.
Both tranches have a maturity of five years with put and call options at the end of years three and four.
The notes pay a coupon of 65 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).

Fees are 21 basis points for lead managers committing US$5-8 million to give an all-in return of 72 basis points over LIBOR, and 15 basis points for managers committing US$3-4 million to give an all-in return of 70 basis points over LIBOR.
